inspections.boundary: The source establishes Kausalya Hart's English rendering of these numbered verses. It does not replace the Tamil text, settle textual variants, verify the poem's theology, or turn polemic, love-sickness, possession, healing, caste, or ritual language into modern empirical findings.

The dissertation supports attributed literary and reception history. It does not establish the wording or detailed interpretation of pasurams 3013-3298 and is never used to override the named translation.
